name: Air Jordan 5 Retro SE 'Burgundy' 2023
story_html: The 2023 edition of the Air Jordan 5 Retro SE ‘Burgundy’ brings back a 2006 colorway from Jordan Brand’s Lifestyle Series. The legacy silhouette utilizes a burgundy suede upper, accented with contrast stitching and breathable translucent netting on the quarter panel. Embroidered Jumpman branding decorates the heel overlay and tongue, treated with a sliver reflective finish for added visibility during low-light conditions. A color-matched polyurethane features speckled shark-tooth detailing and a visible Air-sole unit nestled in the heel. Underfoot, a translucent herringbone-traction outsole delivers reliable grip.
